headword: サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}
gloss: working without pay; unpaid attendance at work; coming to work on a day off without compensation

definitions.gloss: working without pay; unpaid attendance at work; coming to work on a day off without compensation

examples.japanese: サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|し}いられた→強いる：15604_shiiru⟧。
examples.english: I was forced to work without pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{労働基準法|ろうどうきじゅんほう}→労働基準法：17911_roudoukijunhou⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Working on a day off without pay is a violation of the Labor Standards Act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会問題|しゃかいもんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{意識|いしき}される→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: In the past, working without pay was taken for granted, but recently it has come to be recognized as a social problem.

notes:
A compound of ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (here meaning "free of charge" or "complimentary") + ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ (going to work). Part of a family of ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ + work terms that describe unpaid labor.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}→サービス残業：08477_saabisuzangyou⟧: unpaid overtime — working extra hours without overtime pay (the more widely known term)
- サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}: specifically refers to coming in to work on a day off without compensation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|し}いる→強いる：15604_shiiru⟧: to force unpaid work attendance
- サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to refuse to work without pay
- サービス{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{常態化|じょうたいか}→常態化：08024_joutaika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: unpaid work attendance becomes the norm

CULTURAL NOTE:
サービス{出勤|しゅっきん} and ⟦サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}→サービス残業：08477_saabisuzangyou⟧ reflect deep-rooted issues in Japanese work culture. While legally prohibited, social pressure and workplace norms historically made it difficult for employees to refuse. Government reforms and changing attitudes have brought increased scrutiny to these practices.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}→サービス残業：08477_saabisuzangyou⟧: unpaid overtime — the more commonly discussed practice
- {休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん}: working on a day off — neutral term that may or may not be compensated
- ⟦ブラック{企業|きぎょう}→ブラック企業：23311_burakkukigyou⟧: exploitative company — a company known for such practices
